summary.text: Jessica de la Cruz is a Republican state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 23 since 2019, serves as Senate minority leader, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: De la Cruz took office on January 1, 2019, succeeding Paul Fogarty, and the Senate Minority Caucus elected her minority leader on August 2, 2022.
For 2023-2024 she was assigned to the Senate Labor Committee and the Rules, Government Ethics and Oversight Committee.
She advanced from the Republican primary on September 9, 2026.
